rows.grounds: compound with internal sandhi: siddhisaṃprāptiḥ (attainment of powers) + mūlakaulam (root Kaula)

items.question: What is identified as the root Kaula for the fair-faced goddess?
premises: The attainment of powers is equated with the root Kaula.
The fair-faced goddess is directly addressed.
items.inference: The attainment of the eight powers constitutes the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact scope of the eight accomplishments is not specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: And the attainment of the eight powers is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
